title: Reference-Guided Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2603.11210v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model while preserving its general utility. In vision, many approximate unlearning methods pursue this goal through degradation-based heuristics, such as loss maximization or random labeling. Yet making a model worse on forget samples is not the same as making it behave as if those examples had never been seen: these signals can be poorly conditioned, destabilize optimization, and harm generalization. We argue that approximate unlearning should instead prioritize distributional indistinguishability, aligning the model's predictive behavior on forget data with that on truly unseen data. Motivated by this principle, we propose Reference-Guided Unlearning (ReGUn), a vision unlearning framework that uses disjoint held-out data to construct a principled, class-conditioned reference distribution for distillation. translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在从模型中移除特定训练数据的影响，同时保持其通用性能。在视觉领域，许多近似遗忘方法通过基于退化的启发式策略来实现这一目标，例如损失最大化或随机标注。然而，让模型在遗忘样本上表现变差，并不等同于让模型表现得好像从未见过这些样本：这类信号可能条件不佳、破坏优化稳定性并损害泛化能力。我们认为，近似遗忘应当优先追求分布不可区分性，即使模型在遗忘数据上的预测行为与在真正未见数据上的预测行为保持一致。基于这一原则，我们提出了参考引导遗忘，这是一个视觉遗忘框架，它利用不相交的保留数据构建一个有原则的、类别条件化的参考分布用于蒸馏，而非显式地降低模型在……
tldr: 论文提出参考引导遗忘，利用不相交的保留数据构建类别条件化的参考分布进行蒸馏，使模型在遗忘数据上的预测行为与真正未见数据分布不可区分，从而取代传统基于退化（如损失最大化）的遗忘启发式方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Reference-Guided Unlearning (ReGUn), which constructs a principled class-conditioned reference distribution from disjoint held-out data for distillation, aligning the model's predictive behavior on forget data with truly unseen data to achieve distributional indistinguishability rather than relying on degradation-based heuristics.
